In python/mirage/commands/cli/builtin/gh/constants.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/builtin/gh/constants.ts,
HTTP_REASONS are the reason phrases of net/http's StatusText in the Go 1.25.5
standard library (https://github.com/golang/go), the toolchain gh 2.85.0
builds with, and the TEMPLATE_ patterns read the action syntax of its
text/template; and python/mirage/commands/cli/builtin/gh/shape.py,
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/builtin/gh/shape.ts and the fields
modules beside them print a field the way its encoding/json marshals the Go
type gh decodes the field into. Go carries this notice:
